paragraphs.source_en: For Ishida Mitsunari, the only way to reverse his declining fortunes was to attack Fushimi. Yet if he was to take the castle, the best course was to induce its defenders to abandon it of their own accord and win without a battle. For once a siege began, even the smallest castle could exact considerable casualties, and heavy losses might well cause the Western Army, assembled with such difficulty, to collapse.

units.source_en: For Ishida Mitsunari, the only way to reverse his declining fortunes was to attack Fushimi.
units.source_zh: 对于石田三成来说，要想挽回颓势，只能进攻伏见。

units.source_en: Yet if he was to take the castle, the best course was to induce its defenders to abandon it of their own accord and win without a battle.
units.source_zh: 但若是攻城，最好的办法便是让守城方主动放弃，不战而胜。

units.source_en: For once a siege began, even the smallest castle could exact considerable casualties, and heavy losses might well cause the Western Army, assembled with such difficulty, to collapse.

ja.t: するおそれがあったからだ。

units.source_zh: 因为一旦攻起城来，无论多小的城池，也极有可能付出相当的伤亡，伤亡大了，就极可能让好不容易召集起来的西军崩溃。

paragraphs.source_zh: 对于石田三成来说，要想挽回颓势，只能进攻伏见。但若是攻城，最好的办法便是让守城方主动放弃，不战而胜。因为一旦攻起城来，无论多小的城池，也极有可能付出相当的伤亡，伤亡大了，就极可能让好不容易召集起来的西军崩溃。

paragraphs.source_en: After all, Fushimi was an extraordinary castle into whose construction the late Taikō had poured his heart and soul. Though its defenders were few, if they swore to share the castle's fate, it would not be so easily taken.

units.source_en: After all, Fushimi was an extraordinary castle into whose construction the late Taikō had poured his heart and soul.
units.source_zh: 怎么说，伏见也是已故太阁生前倾注心血建造的稀世城池。

units.source_en: Though its defenders were few, if they swore to share the castle's fate, it would not be so easily taken.
units.source_zh: 即使守城人数不多，但他们若誓与城池共存亡，也非那般容易就能拿下。

paragraphs.source_zh: 怎么说，伏见也是已故太阁生前倾注心血建造的稀世城池。即使守城人数不多，但他们若誓与城池共存亡，也非那般容易就能拿下。

paragraphs.source_en: For that very reason, Mitsunari began by offering every inducement he could, striving to persuade Torii Mototada to surrender. He tried every conceivable means to achieve his aim. If Uesugi and Ieyasu, who had marched east against him, could quickly be drawn into a fierce battle, Mototada, cut off from news, would grow anxious.

units.source_en: For that very reason, Mitsunari began by offering every inducement he could, striving to persuade Torii Mototada to surrender.
units.source_zh: 正因如此，一开始时，三成把所有诱饵都抛了出去，力图说服鸟居元忠投降。

units.source_en: He tried every conceivable means to achieve his aim.
units.source_zh: 为达到目的，他真是想尽办法。

units.source_en: If Uesugi and Ieyasu, who had marched east against him, could quickly be drawn into a fierce battle, Mototada, cut off from news, would grow anxious.
units.source_zh: 若让上杉与东征的家康尽快发生一场激战，这样一来，消息闭塞的元忠就会着急起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正因如此，一开始时，三成把所有诱饵都抛了出去，力图说服鸟居元忠投降。为达到目的，他真是想尽办法。若让上杉与东征的家康尽快发生一场激战，这样一来，消息闭塞的元忠就会着急起来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lead your men out of the castle at once. We shall never pursue you from behind. Hurry east and join the Naifu.”

units.source_en: “Lead your men out of the castle at once. We shall never pursue you from behind. Hurry east and join the Naifu.”
units.source_zh: “赶快带领人马出城，我们绝不会在背后追击，赶紧东去与内府会师。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “赶快带领人马出城，我们绝不会在背后追击，赶紧东去与内府会师。”

paragraphs.source_en: Thus provoked, the brave but rash Torii Mototada, who had been worrying constantly about his lord, would answer, “My thanks! Mototada shall never forget your kindness.” Then he would naturally race away to the east.

units.source_en: Thus provoked, the brave but rash Torii Mototada, who had been worrying constantly about his lord, would answer, “My thanks!
units.source_zh: 如此一煽动，有勇无谋、一直惦念主君的鸟居元忠就会应道：“多谢！

units.source_en: Mototada shall never forget your kindness.”
units.source_zh: 大人的恩情，元忠不会忘记。”

units.source_en: Then he would naturally race away to the east.
units.source_zh: 自会向东面疾驰而去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如此一煽动，有勇无谋、一直惦念主君的鸟居元忠就会应道：“多谢！大人的恩情，元忠不会忘记。”自会向东面疾驰而去。

paragraphs.source_en: That had been Mitsunari's fond calculation, but the situation in Aizu showed no progress whatsoever. Tokugawa Ieyasu was in no hurry to attack, and Uesugi made no move either. Consequently, to raise his army's spirits, Mitsunari had no choice but to lay siege to Fushimi Castle. Yet once the castle was surrounded, the fighting spirit of Mototada and his men would naturally soar. The siege was truly an act of sheer necessity.

units.source_en: That had been Mitsunari's fond calculation, but the situation in Aizu showed no progress whatsoever.
units.source_zh: 这原本是三成的如意算盘，可是，会津方面的形势没有任何进展。

units.source_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu was in no hurry to attack, and Uesugi made no move either.

ja.t: けようとはしなかった。

units.source_zh: 德川家康不急于进攻，上杉方面也不主动出手。

units.source_en: Consequently, to raise his army's spirits, Mitsunari had no choice but to lay siege to Fushimi Castle.
units.source_zh: 这样一来，为了鼓舞士气，三成就不得不包围伏见城。

units.source_en: Yet once the castle was surrounded, the fighting spirit of Mototada and his men would naturally soar.
units.source_zh: 而一旦围城，元忠等人的斗志自会高涨。

units.source_en: The siege was truly an act of sheer necessity.

ja.t: はまさに、やむにやまれぬ

units.source_zh: 围城真是迫不得已！

paragraphs.source_zh: 这原本是三成的如意算盘，可是，会津方面的形势没有任何进展。德川家康不急于进攻，上杉方面也不主动出手。这样一来，为了鼓舞士气，三成就不得不包围伏见城。而一旦围城，元忠等人的斗志自会高涨。围城真是迫不得已！

paragraphs.source_en: Even after his envoy was rebuffed and his troops encircled Fushimi, Mitsunari did not give up. Once battle was joined, however, the Jibu-shōyū—rich in intelligence but short on combat experience—had no stratagem left to employ. And once all manner of rumors began to spread, he feared he would meekly have to relinquish supreme command.

units.source_en: Even after his envoy was rebuffed and his troops encircled Fushimi, Mitsunari did not give up.
units.source_zh: 在使者受拒，兵围伏见之后，三成依然没有放弃。

units.source_en: Once battle was joined, however, the Jibu-shōyū—rich in intelligence but short on combat experience—had no stratagem left to employ.
units.source_zh: 一旦双方交战，智慧有余、作战经验不足的治部少辅却也无计可施。

units.source_en: And once all manner of rumors began to spread, he feared he would meekly have to relinquish supreme command.
units.source_zh: 而一旦各类风言风语传扬开来，他恐要乖乖交出指挥大权。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在使者受拒，兵围伏见之后，三成依然没有放弃。一旦双方交战，智慧有余、作战经验不足的治部少辅却也无计可施。而一旦各类风言风语传扬开来，他恐要乖乖交出指挥大权。

paragraphs.source_en: In pursuing victory without battle, Mitsunari naturally did not forget Kinoshita Katsutoshi inside the castle.

units.source_en: In pursuing victory without battle, Mitsunari naturally did not forget Kinoshita Katsutoshi inside the castle.
units.source_zh: 为了达到不战而胜的目的，三成当然不会忘了城里的木下胜俊。

paragraphs.source_zh: 为了达到不战而胜的目的，三成当然不会忘了城里的木下胜俊。

paragraphs.source_en: If an attack truly had to be launched, any delay might make the situation exceedingly dangerous. Torii Mototada would surely defend the castle to the death while awaiting reinforcements from Ieyasu.

units.source_en: If an attack truly had to be launched, any delay might make the situation exceedingly dangerous.
units.source_zh: 既然必须要发起进攻，一旦耽误了时日，形势恐大为不妙。

units.source_en: Torii Mototada would surely defend the castle to the death while awaiting reinforcements from Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 鸟居元忠定会一边死守城池，一边等待家康援军。

paragraphs.source_zh: 既然必须要发起进攻，一旦耽误了时日，形势恐大为不妙。鸟居元忠定会一边死守城池，一边等待家康援军。

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, Mototada was merely obeying Ieyasu's orders, seeking through resistance to break the Western Army's morale. He believed that if Mitsunari grew afraid, his formation would fall into disorder of its own accord. If the Western Army learned that Ieyasu was returning before it had taken Fushimi, its men would be unable to sleep at night.

units.source_en: In truth, Mototada was merely obeying Ieyasu's orders, seeking through resistance to break the Western Army's morale.

ja.t: をくじこうとしているだけだった。

units.source_zh: 其实，元忠只是遵家康命令，想通过抵抗挫败西军士气。

units.source_en: He believed that if Mitsunari grew afraid, his formation would fall into disorder of its own accord.
units.source_zh: 他认为，一旦三成心生畏惧，自会阵脚大乱。

units.source_en: If the Western Army learned that Ieyasu was returning before it had taken Fushimi, its men would be unable to sleep at night.

ja.t: れなくなるはずだった。

units.source_zh: 西军若在伏见得手之前就得知家康回师，士众必夜不能寐。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，元忠只是遵家康命令，想通过抵抗挫败西军士气。他认为，一旦三成心生畏惧，自会阵脚大乱。西军若在伏见得手之前就得知家康回师，士众必夜不能寐。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus, on the nineteenth day of the seventh month of Keichō 5, the siege began. A ceaseless barrage poured upon Fushimi Castle, and the garrison returned fire from time to time.

units.source_en: Thus, on the nineteenth day of the seventh month of Keichō 5, the siege began.
units.source_zh: 于是，庆长五年七月十九，攻城战开打。

units.source_en: A ceaseless barrage poured upon Fushimi Castle, and the garrison returned fire from time to time.
units.source_zh: 炮火不断倾向伏见城，城内也不时予以回击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 于是，庆长五年七月十九，攻城战开打。炮火不断倾向伏见城，城内也不时予以回击。

paragraphs.source_en: By the twenty-fifth, Fushimi Castle lay utterly silent, and though its fall appeared only a matter of time, the Western Army grew ever more impatient. Every point except the southern main gate was encircled several ranks deep. On the twenty-fourth, Ukita Hideie had personally directed the assault.

units.source_en: By the twenty-fifth, Fushimi Castle lay utterly silent, and though its fall appeared only a matter of time, the Western Army grew ever more impatient.
units.source_zh: 到二十五日，伏见城内静悄悄一片，城池的陷落只是迟早问题了，西军却越发焦急起来。

units.source_en: Every point except the southern main gate was encircled several ranks deep.
units.source_zh: 除了南大门，所有地方都加以重重包围。

units.source_en: On the twenty-fourth, Ukita Hideie had personally directed the assault.
units.source_zh: 在二十四日，宇喜多秀家亲自指挥攻城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 到二十五日，伏见城内静悄悄一片，城池的陷落只是迟早问题了，西军却越发焦急起来。除了南大门，所有地方都加以重重包围。在二十四日，宇喜多秀家亲自指挥攻城。

paragraphs.source_en: By then, both sides had long forgotten how much labor the late Taikō had expended in building this castle, how many people's devotion and wisdom it embodied, and how much wealth it had consumed. Fushimi Castle, symbol of the peerless hero Toyotomi Hideyoshi's achievements, had now become an infernal field of slaughter. The two sides bore one another no grievance or hatred, yet now they had wholly become madmen who knew only destruction and killing.

units.source_en: By then, both sides had long forgotten how much labor the late Taikō had expended in building this castle, how many people's devotion and wisdom it embodied, and how much wealth it had consumed.
units.source_zh: 此时，交战双方早已忘记当初已故太阁在建此城时花费了多少人力，凝聚了多少人的心血智慧，耗费了多少财富！

units.source_en: Fushimi Castle, symbol of the peerless hero Toyotomi Hideyoshi's achievements, had now become an infernal field of slaughter.
units.source_zh: 这座象征盖世英雄丰臣秀吉伟业的伏见城，如今却成了杀戮的修罗场！

units.source_en: The two sides bore one another no grievance or hatred, yet now they had wholly become madmen who knew only destruction and killing.
units.source_zh: 双方无冤无仇，但此时全然成了只知破坏和屠杀的疯子。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，交战双方早已忘记当初已故太阁在建此城时花费了多少人力，凝聚了多少人的心血智慧，耗费了多少财富！这座象征盖世英雄丰臣秀吉伟业的伏见城，如今却成了杀戮的修罗场！双方无冤无仇，但此时全然成了只知破坏和屠杀的疯子。

paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-fifth, the order for a general assault was given. Amid battle cries, the castle Toyotomi Hideyoshi had once labored so painstakingly to build was beset by fire arrows, arquebuses, and spears, and the earth-shaking din never ceased for an instant.

units.source_en: On the twenty-fifth, the order for a general assault was given. Amid battle cries, the castle Toyotomi Hideyoshi had once labored so painstakingly to build was beset by fire arrows, arquebuses, and spears, and the earth-shaking din never ceased for an instant.
units.source_zh: 二十五日，总攻命令下达，呐喊声中，这座丰臣秀吉曾苦心经营的城池陷入了火箭、火枪和长矛的攻击之中，那声音惊天动地，时刻不休。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十五日，总攻命令下达，呐喊声中，这座丰臣秀吉曾苦心经营的城池陷入了火箭、火枪和长矛的攻击之中，那声音惊天动地，时刻不休。

paragraphs.source_en: Sheltering in forts, turrets, and along the walls, the defending officers and men fought back valiantly with bows, guns, and cannon; they withdrew when the enemy advanced and rested when the enemy retreated, never daring to relax in the slightest.

units.source_en: Sheltering in forts, turrets, and along the walls, the defending officers and men fought back valiantly with bows, guns, and cannon; they withdrew when the enemy advanced and rested when the enemy retreated, never daring to relax in the slightest.
units.source_zh: 守城官兵躲在堡垒、炮楼、城墙等地，以弓箭、枪炮奋勇回击，敌进则退，敌退则休，丝毫不敢懈怠。

paragraphs.source_zh: 守城官兵躲在堡垒、炮楼、城墙等地，以弓箭、枪炮奋勇回击，敌进则退，敌退则休，丝毫不敢懈怠。

paragraphs.source_en: On the afternoon of the twenty-ninth, Ishida Mitsunari, who until then had left a field deputy to oversee the siege, could endure no longer and came to Fushimi while traveling from Sawayama back to Osaka.

units.source_en: On the afternoon of the twenty-ninth, Ishida Mitsunari, who until then had left a field deputy to oversee the siege, could endure no longer and came to Fushimi while traveling from Sawayama back to Osaka.
units.source_zh: 二十九日下午，在此之前，一直派阵代监督攻城的石田三成终于忍耐不住，在从佐和山回大坂途中来到了伏见。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十九日下午，在此之前，一直派阵代监督攻城的石田三成终于忍耐不住，在从佐和山回大坂途中来到了伏见。

paragraphs.source_en: He immediately made a circuit of inspection on horseback. The besieging troops were exerting themselves to the utmost, but since the defenders had sworn to perish with the castle, even he was powerless to change the brutal state of affairs. When serving as an inspector during the invasion of Korea, Mitsunari had enforced military discipline so harshly that the commanders and soldiers deeply resented him; now, however, he did not dare rebuke them as he had then.

units.source_en: He immediately made a circuit of inspection on horseback.
units.source_zh: 他立刻骑马巡视了一圈。

units.source_en: The besieging troops were exerting themselves to the utmost, but since the defenders had sworn to perish with the castle, even he was powerless to change the brutal state of affairs.
units.source_zh: 攻城部队全力以赴，但因守城士众已誓与城池同归于尽，他亦无力改变惨烈的现状。

units.source_en: When serving as an inspector during the invasion of Korea, Mitsunari had enforced military discipline so harshly that the commanders and soldiers deeply resented him; now, however, he did not dare rebuke them as he had then.
units.source_zh: 当初做监军攻打朝鲜时，三成曾军法严厉，因此令众将士大为反感，现在他却根本不敢如当初般斥责众人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他立刻骑马巡视了一圈。攻城部队全力以赴，但因守城士众已誓与城池同归于尽，他亦无力改变惨烈的现状。当初做监军攻打朝鲜时，三成曾军法严厉，因此令众将士大为反感，现在他却根本不敢如当初般斥责众人。

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari halted outside the moat at the pine garden and sank into thought: he could neither sever the enemy's supply route nor carry out a flooding attack. At this rate, even after a month of attacks, Fushimi Castle would remain unmoved.

units.source_en: Mitsunari halted outside the moat at the pine garden and sank into thought: he could neither sever the enemy's supply route nor carry out a flooding attack.
units.source_zh: 三成停在松苑的护城河外沉思起来：既不能截断对方粮道，也无法实施水攻。

units.source_en: At this rate, even after a month of attacks, Fushimi Castle would remain unmoved.

ja.t: はびくともしないだろう。

units.source_zh: 长此下去，即使进攻一月，伏见城也照样纹丝不动。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成停在松苑的护城河外沉思起来：既不能截断对方粮道，也无法实施水攻。长此下去，即使进攻一月，伏见城也照样纹丝不动。

paragraphs.source_en: Was there anything in the world harder to overcome than men unafraid of death? Moreover, nearly all the defenders had followed Ieyasu since childhood, and their wives and children were not there. If they united in a defense to the death, would the castle not be impregnable?

units.source_en: Was there anything in the world harder to overcome than men unafraid of death?
units.source_zh: 世上还有比不怕死的人更难对付的吗？

units.source_en: Moreover, nearly all the defenders had followed Ieyasu since childhood, and their wives and children were not there.

ja.t: もここにはいなかった。

units.source_zh: 而且，守城的几乎都是自幼追随家康之人，他们的妻小也不在这里。

units.source_en: If they united in a defense to the death, would the castle not be impregnable?
units.source_zh: 众人只要协心死守，岂非固若金汤？

paragraphs.source_zh: 世上还有比不怕死的人更难对付的吗？而且，守城的几乎都是自幼追随家康之人，他们的妻小也不在这里。众人只要协心死守，岂非固若金汤？

paragraphs.source_en: Where, then, should the main attack be directed? The castle had long since prepared its defenses; wherever they attacked, they would be driven back on the spot.

units.source_en: Where, then, should the main attack be directed?
units.source_zh: 究竟重点攻击何处为好呢？

units.source_en: The castle had long since prepared its defenses; wherever they attacked, they would be driven back on the spot.
units.source_zh: 城内早就有防备，无论从何处进攻，都会被当场击退。

paragraphs.source_zh: 究竟重点攻击何处为好呢？城内早就有防备，无论从何处进攻，都会被当场击退。

paragraphs.source_en: If casualties were disregarded and waves of men were hurled at the castle, the defenders might perhaps give way. But who would be willing to accept such losses? Besides, though a vast army pressed upon them, those within the castle showed no fear at all.

units.source_en: If casualties were disregarded and waves of men were hurled at the castle, the defenders might perhaps give way.
units.source_zh: 若不计伤亡，采用人海战术，守城方或许会放弃。

units.source_en: But who would be willing to accept such losses?
units.source_zh: 但是，这种伤亡有谁愿意接受？

units.source_en: Besides, though a vast army pressed upon them, those within the castle showed no fear at all.
units.source_zh: 况且，大军压境，城内众人却毫不畏惧。

paragraphs.source_zh: 若不计伤亡，采用人海战术，守城方或许会放弃。但是，这种伤亡有谁愿意接受？况且，大军压境，城内众人却毫不畏惧。

paragraphs.source_en: Although Mōri Terumoto presided over Osaka Castle, no one believed that Terumoto would make such a sacrifice, while Hideyori was no more than a puppet. Mitsunari stared at the turret of the pine garden and pondered for a long while before summoning a messenger and ordering him, “Go at once to Natsuka Masaie's camp. Among the men of Kōka there should be a man named Ukai Tōsuke with the field deputy Ban Gohei. Bring him here immediately.”

units.source_en: Although Mōri Terumoto presided over Osaka Castle, no one believed that Terumoto would make such a sacrifice, while Hideyori was no more than a puppet.
units.source_zh: 尽管大坂城内有毛利辉元坐镇，可无一人认为辉元愿作这种牺牲，而秀赖不过一介傀儡。

units.source_en: Mitsunari stared at the turret of the pine garden and pondered for a long while before summoning a messenger and ordering him, “Go at once to Natsuka Masaie's camp. Among the men of Kōka there should be a man named Ukai Tōsuke with the field deputy Ban Gohei. Bring him here immediately.”
